hero.caption: Coldwater covered Bridge Oxford,Alabama.  Built in 1850, the 63 foot bridge was moved to Oxford from nearby Coldwater and restored to preserve the landmark that is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.  It currently spans a small outflow from the Oxford Lake and is maintained by the city.
